decisions.name: 2.2 Kummer's Theorem
decisions.reason: This ramification-theoretic theorem concerns factorization of primes in extensions of number fields rather than the Galois-theoretic Kummer correspondence built on this page.
decisions.evidence: Ghorpade §2.2 is the ramification-theoretic Kummer theorem about factorization of primes in extensions of number fields. GA-4 builds the Galois-theoretic Kummer correspondence and solvability-by-radicals block, not ramification theory, and the current plan has no in-order ramification page to receive this result. The owner-level destination is therefore correct.
